summary: Compositing and layers work focused on correctness for scrolling, gesture handing, and video playback. Async Pan/Zoom (APZ) improvements make handed-off pan gestures and scroll reporting more reliable, compositor scroll updates are batched for efficiency, and native scrolling support was extended. Importantly, hardware-decoded HDR video metadata is now passed through to the compositor so HDR content can display with the correct luminance and color on capable displays, and Metal/ANGLE synchronization and GPU-fence handling were beefed up to make compositor interactions more stable.
